Nadia Park: FYI  BlueCap QBR scheduled Thurs 11am PT. Need one slide: health snapshot + one slide with two incentive options if renewal risk = medium/high. Who owns what?
Omar Rahman: Ill take the health snapshot  will pull DAU, integration success %, and top 2 blockers. ETA Wed noon.
Felix Dunn: Ill draft the incentive options (short-term onboarding hours vs usage credit) and a 1-line ROI estimate.
deck-bot: Reminder created: slide freeze Wed 6pm PT.
Nadia Park: Also include a 30-day feedback snippet (one quote + net sentiment). Omar, can you add that when you pull issues?
Omar Rahman: Yep. Quick query Im running:
SELECT count(*) AS cnt, category FROM onboarding_issues WHERE created_at > now() - interval '30 days' GROUP BY category ORDER BY cnt DESC;
Felix Dunn: Ill keep incentive slide concise: option A (3-day onboarding sprint, est 40% time-to-onboard reduction), option B (10% usage credit for 2 months).
Nadia Park: Owners recap: Omar = health + feedback; Felix = incentives + impact; Nadia = assemble + rehearse. Ill book a 15-min dry run Wed 1pm PT. :thumbsup:
deck-bot: Event scheduled: "BlueCap QBR dry run" Wed 13:00-13:15 PT  attendees: Nadia, Omar, Felix.
